senses.gloss:
मोह मोह, i. e. मुह् + अ, m.
 1. Fainting, Vikr. 84, 10; loss of consciousness, Vikr. d. 8.
 2. Bewilderment, distraction, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 13; Ṛt. 6, 26.
 3. Weakness of intellect, Man. 3, 15.
 4. Ignorance, foolishness, infatuation, Pañc. i. d. 250; iii. d. 87.
 5. Error, Matsyop. 53.

मोहन मोहन, i. e. मुह् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Depriving of consciousness or understanding, infatuating, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 13; Kathās. 46, 110 (with विद्या, A magical knowledge).
 II. m. One of the arrows of Kāma, Lass. 7, 3.
 III. n. Temptation, the overpowering [] of reason by sensual allurements.
 --Comp.

मोहिन् मोहिन्, i. e. मुह् + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Bewildering, infatuating, Bhag. 9, 12.
 II. f. नी, A kind of jasmine.
मोहन- + लता मोहन- + लता, f. a fascinating plant, Lass. 82, 14 (Prākṛ.).
मोह- + वश मोह- + वश (n.), unconsciousness (literally, power of unconsciousness), Chr. 36, 21.
